descriptions.w3d_fn_80062640: Creates two quake loops, separates their pitch, sets their volume and positions, and starts playback.
descriptions.w3d_fn_800627a4: Raises quake-loop volume toward a limit and updates both loop positions.
descriptions.w3d_fn_80062884: Stops and releases both earthquake sound loops when the sound manager is present.
descriptions.w3d_fn_80062950: Positions the earthquake loops on opposite sides of the current camera.
